verdict.rationale: Ramp's Banking API/Treasury docs confirm a business 'can have more than one' Checking Account (WALLET_ACCOUNT), supporting the multi-sub-account part of the story, and Treasury automation exists for moving money between accounts to hit target balances. However, no evidence describes auto-allocating incoming deposits across multiple checking sub-accounts — the only allocation feature documented is 'auto top-up from linked checking accounts with target balance automation' (ramp-docs-6), which moves funds INTO Ramp from external accounts, not distributing incoming deposits across several Ramp sub-accounts. Missing for 10: documented deposit-splitting/allocation rules across sub-accounts, UI/API for defining allocation percentages, and any customer evidence of this specific waterfall behavior.
